title: Variable format string (c) — review required
description: A c formatting call uses a variable as its format string: printf(userstr). Conversion specifiers in the value read and write process memory. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the value is fixed or passes it as an argument.
remediation: Use a fixed format string (a fixed "%s" format) and pass the value as an argument.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches a variable-only call to the named formatter; fixed formats with variable arguments never match, and identifiers that merely end in the formatter name (for example sprintf wrappers around printf) are outside this rule.
